en: And so, this year, I decided to let Fiena come to me first.
I'll admit, I don't have much faith in her... But we'll just have to wait and see.
Oh, right, she did say something like that at the tea party last year.
I just hope she doesn't fall asleep in some bush on the way.
She's not a very reliable witch, to put it lightly.
You don't have many kind words to say about her, yet you seem to get along with her very well.
She's kind at heart despite the way she acts.
If only she wasn't intoxicated all the time...
Oh! She really came on time!?
Is nobody in?
Wait a moment!
Come in!
Sil, it's been a while.
Right...
Last time you were here, you were sprawled all over my floor.
Ugh, I'm getting annoyed just remembering it.
What are you talking about?
Our relationship extends little beyond our contractual obligations regarding the Tea Party.
I don't recall us spending any personal time together.
Huh?
As for sprawling on floors...
I don't do such unsightly things.
Hmm, what a sorry excuse for a witch's domain.
...You... You are Fiena, right?
Astonishing. You don't even recognize the owner of the flower garden.
Have you been so absorbed in your needlework that your eyes have become buttonholes?
Of course I recognize you, it's just... what happened to you?
You're usually stumbling all over and spouting random gibberish.
I don't know who you're talking about, but she doesn't sound worthy of the title of witch.
It's... It's you...?
Enough small talk.
We have a lot left to do. Follow.
What the...
You saw that too, right, Canele? Isn't she acting strange?
What's new? She's always acting strange.
Good point. But this is too strange even for her...
Maybe she finally fried her brain from drinking too much of her concoctions.
Maybe. But just the sight of her now...
Really, really annoys me.
At last the tea party should go off without a hitch this time around.
I'm more focused on getting her back to normal right now.
I'll have to go see the others.
Perhaps we can work out together what Fiena's up to.
Good luck with that.
Fiena...
You're not acting like yourself. Did something happen?
What do you mean...? I'm the same as I've always been.
But really, what is up with this domain?
I can already smell rotting soil.
It's always like that here. It's basically a giant farm.
A witch who can't even manage her own domain properly...
I'm going to meet her and give her a good talking-to.
Hmm...
Where's the Fiena I know gone?
Ah, Abigail. You were waiting for us.
What's wrong?
Something has... changed.
Are you really the real Fiena?
Do you not recognize the owner of the flower garden herself?
Hmm... Well, I suppose a lesser witch such as yourself might not know me by sight.
Forgive her, Abigail.
Fiena's a little... stranger than usual today.
But is it too much to ask for you to maintain your realm somewhat?
What have you been doing while the place became overrun with monsters?
Enough nagging, Fiena.
You don't want to provoke Abigail...
You've always been strange, Fiena. But this is too much even for you.
I'd prefer not to have to deal with you.
Ha, just the kind of comment I'd expect from a witch covered in soil and muck.
Can you at least do the bare minimum of washing your face before the tea party?
I'll bury you under all this soil and muck.
Here we go...
What's wrong with you, Fiena?
Why would you speak to Abigail like that?
I am merely giving back as well as I got.
And Abigail! You!
I told you not to swing the scythe out of nowhere, didn't I?
I'd like to slice that head of Fiena's clean off.
Perhaps that will help return her to normal.
I'd like the old Fiena back too...
But I'd like to ask the others if they have better, less violent ideas first.
...Fine.
What are you two whispering about?
J-Just discussing ideas for how to make this the best tea party yet!
Hmm, perhaps you're more serious about our contractual obligations than I thought.
Good.
I'm not happy about having to sit through a pointless fight... But I shall take the high road.
You only need to put up with her until the tea party.
Oh? Who's this I spy with my little eye?
Come on in, Sil!
And is that our loyal customer Fiena I see beside you?
Have you come to enjoy our club together?
Goodness me, Sil. What is this assault on the eyes?
Why would anyone decorate their realm like this...?
Being forced to spend the rest of their days trapped within their nightmares would be too lenient on them!
It's kinda fun seeing their predictable reactions.
Hehe, I see.
So it's finally happened.
Our worst fear has come to fruition.
This is why we cannot abide the living... Tsk, tsk.
Care to explain?
Do you two know something about why Fiena's like this?
Hehe, indeed we do.
Curious, aren't ya?
Then... As always, join us up on our club's main stage!
And we'd be happy to whisper the secret to you, hehehe!
Wait! Stop!
...They're already gone.
Weren't those witches also invited to the Tea Party?
Yes, unfortunately.
Then hurry up and chase after them instead of standing there like a fool!
All right, all right. Patience...
You're amazing, Sil. You made it all the way to the main stage in one go!
You must really want to know Fiena's little secret.
Or are you just desperate to drag us to the tea party? Teehee...
Hmm... Why not both?
My, my, aren't you a greedy girl!
We want one thing, and one thing only...
And that's you, Sil!
Alas, our new maid...
Looks like we'll have to sew her back up.
Hurry up and tell me how to turn Fiena back to normal.
Hahaha! Isn't it obvious?
Fine, we've had our fun. We'll tell you...
You see, Fiena is... completely, 100% clear-headed.
...Are you sure? She's absolutely nothing like herself, though.
That's exactly what I said.
She's been drinking her concoction of honey and venom her entire life. The "normal" Fiena we know and love is always intoxicated.
So, what you're saying is...
This is just what Fiena is like clear-headed?
Wasn't it obvious? Haven't you known her a long time?
I mean... I've never seen her clear-headed before.
Fret not!
A single sip of her usual concoction should be all it takes to have her back to her old self.
Here, we've been keeping a few bottles in reserve as insurance just in case a day like this ever came...
See if you can get her to drink some.
But you better be careful when you do.
Spilling any on yourself could kill you!
Well, if it's her favorite drink...
Hey, Fiena.
Aren't you thirsty? Want a nice, refreshing drink?
Eck! What is that in your hand?
It stinks like death itself! Get it away from me!
Uh-oh...
I'll have to excuse myself.
I can't bear to spend another second in this hellhole.
And to think, I've lost count of the times I've caught her licking up whatever's fallen on the floor.
Either way, it looks like she has no intention of letting that drink anywhere near her.
Which leaves... Plan B.
It seems she's super serious about having this tea party go smoothly. So let's take advantage of that.
Aha! You're a genius!
Everybody shares food during a tea party!
I can't believe these words are coming out of my mouth, but...
I like your plan.
Now we know what to do, let's not waste any time.
We need to get it done before Fiena notices something is off!
What took you so long in there?
We're going to be late.
Nothing! Let's go!
Phew, that was close.
We just about made it here on schedule.
I trust you're ready for the tea party?
I've never seen you so lucid and graceful before, Fiena.
It's truly a pleasure.
The pleasure is all mine. It's a relief to finally meet a proper witch.
Honestly, the things I've had to put up with so far...
You've taken the words right out of my mouth!
I never thought this day would come...
There's finally a proper witch in our garden beside me!
Hehe, not for much longer.
...What was that?
Ahem!! N-Nothing!
Let's hurry on to the tea party!
That's what we're all here for after all, right?!
What she said! It's almost time, isn't it?!
Let's not be late for once, eh?
All right, spit it out.
What nefarious scheme are you up to this time?!
N-Nefarious scheme!? Such pure, innocent witches as us would never be up to anything!
Never ever!
Heh... Heh heh...
Aha, that's it! It's so obvious.
You're trying to turn Fiena back into a useless wreck again!
You wicked witches... Can't you leave her be clear-headed for once?
I don't know what exactly it is you're planning... but I'm not letting you turn her into a bumbling, stumbling fool again!
But we like the bumbling, stumbling Fiena more than this one!
Then so be it...
You leave me no other choice but force!
Urk...!
We win!!
We!? You were just standing on the sidelines watching!
Fighting is not our forte.
What's all this bickering about?
And Chloe...
I thought you were a witch of some dignity, but you're a disappointment like all the others.
D-Disappointment?!
Eek! There's a nightmare skittering out of the bedroom!
Looks like Nahatra is waking up.
I'll deal with this, you focus on getting the tea party ready.
What kind of nightmare is she having this time?
Sorry, Nahatra, we've been having some trouble because of Fiena.
The tea party is completely off schedule... I'm so ashamed!
I can't believe I was scolded by Fiena of all witches...
The poor girl is in shock.
Hehehe, she'll be thanking us soon.
Let's get started.
With a knot woven by the Thread Witch.
With dewdrops brewed by the Flower Witch.
With soil sprinkled by the Pumpkin Witch.
With flesh devoured by the Blood Witch.
With a flame lit by the Wax Witch.
In the name of all witches, we will now host our tea party.
Hmm, now it's starting to feel like a true gathering of witches.
Shall we make a toast?
May I fill your glass, my elegant witch?
Freeze, wicked witch!
What are you trying to feed Fiena?!
The same thing she's been drinking for years.
Exactly!
And if she puts it in her mouth now, she'll carry on drinking it forever!
That's the hope.
Be honest, Chloe. You want the old Fiena back too, don't you?
W-Well...
Not this way!!
Please allow me to apologize for their shameful behavior.
Hmm, as long as you're enjoying yourself.
All right, I'll have a taste of something.
Anything but this drink you're trying to foist on me.
Oh, this pumpkin pie sure looks tasty.
Let's have a bite...
Hmm... This taste is...
...is... Mmph!!! Urk...!
Ack! My chest... is burning!!
Fiena?
Is something wrong?
Hyuck... Heh... Hehehehe...!
Hoohoohoo!! Hahahahaha!!! Heeeeeeeee!!
This taste is the beeeeeeeeest!!!!!!
The burning in my throat gives me life!
Wait a second...
Aha! The Fiena we all know and love has returned!
Hoohoohoo, why're y'all lookin' at me like that?
And why am I so thirsty?
Here! It's your favorite!
Thank you, dear Berry! Bottoms up! ♪
W-What's going on?
Clear-headed Fiena... is the worst.
And so, I added a secret ingredient to the pumpkin pie...
The concoction Rims and Berry brought along.
Great job, Abigail!
You did what!?
Ugh, just when I thought there might be someone else normal in the garden...
So, we really managed it...
This tea party really went by in the blink of an eye, eh?
I don't remember any of it! Yahahahahaha!
Bleeerghhh!!
Eek! Not on the floor!!
Bluueeeeerggghhhh!!!
Yuck.
Phew, the smell of Fiena's vomit... The world is right again.
Perhaps Fiena wasn't quite suited for the role of tea party hostess.
So what do we do now?
Ahem! Ahem...!
Are you on the lookout for a party expert?
Then look no further...!
No way. Not at all.
Hmph...
Why not let Abigail have a try?
Abigail? Will that be okay?
I'm sure she'd love to give it a go!
Fine. But only once.
Hooray!
Maybe this is a good opportunity for Abigail to leave her farm.
Phew...
Whoever's in charge, just make sure you're on time.
Humpty dumpty dum... Halalalala...
Huh!? My brand new front door!!
Abigail?!
You're supposed to knock!
Not smash the door down!!
...Knock?
You know, tapping it with your knuckles.
I did tap it. And it fell over.
Well, can you tap a little softer next time?
Anyway, why are you here?
I don't think you've ever visited before...
Tea party.
It's time.
Oh, already?
Is this your farm?
Your furniture looks soft.
So many things I've never seen before.
This isn't a farm.
Every witch's realm looks and feels different.
You're the only one with a realm that looks like a pumpkin patch.
...I see.
You have a dog, too.
I'm a cat.
A talking cat.
Okay. I'm leaving.
Already?
I need to gather with other witches.
Alone? Do you know the way?
I'll be fine.
As much as I'd love to leave all the work to someone else...
Going to the other witches' realms alone...
Hmm...
What is it?
Something about Abigail going to find the others on her own makes me nervous.
Like a prophetic vision of the garden burning to the ground before the tea party even starts.
Bye.
Don't be late.
Wait!
I'll go with you.
I don't feel comfortable sending you off alone.
Do you know the way?
Of course, nobody else knows them better.
I'll teach you how to deal with all our mischievous fellow witches.
Okay.
Hopefully this will help get Abigail more interested in the tea party.
That will certainly be a weight off my shoulders.
Maybe.
If things work out...
